services.name: Behavioural Consultation
services.short: One-on-one with a trainer and a clear plan of action.
services.intro: A private, in-person consultation at the facility for dogs over 7 months with behavioural challenges. Your trainer observes your dog, talks through your options and recommends a plan of action. 30 minutes in a 45-minute slot, $50.
learn: We observe your dog in the meeting area, around your car, you, the trainer and the trainer’s dogs
We discuss the training options we offer
You get feedback and a recommended training plan
requirements: Dogs over 7 months with behavioural challenges
Not a prerequisite for Puppy Class or Bootcamp Level 1

markerTraining: Marker (or clicker) training is an animal training method based on behavioural psychology that relies on marking desirable behaviour and rewarding it. This black and white method of communication is based on positive reinforcement. You’ll learn the power of training with food, building the dog/handler relationship through engagement and motivation, the basics of luring, leash pressure and shaping, classical and operant conditioning, and how to build motivation through productive play. Marker training can be used to train any behaviour, from basic obedience and tricks to behavioural modification.
